parts.label: Stator windings
parts.note: Three-phase AC here makes a rotating magnetic field

parts.label: Stator core
parts.note: Laminated steel ring; the windings sit in its slots

parts.label: Squirrel-cage rotor
parts.note: Induced currents in its bars make it turn

parts.label: End ring
parts.note: Shorts all the bars together at each end

parts.label: Shaft
parts.note: Carries the turning force out to the load

parts.label: Cooling fan
parts.note: Turns with the shaft and blows air over the frame

parts.label: Finned frame
parts.note: Fins give more surface to shed heat

parts.label: Terminal box
parts.note: The three supply phases connect here
